title: Echofield
tagline: A procedural action slice set after the Sundering, when four ages were crushed into one continent.
stateNote: A browser action slice with Low, Medium and High quality settings.
problem: What if a world were stitched out of four different ages? You play a seamwalker crossing the seam from Crosscamp to the Chrome Needle.
audience: Players of exploration and action games, and procedural-generation fans.
contribution: It is my project. The README says the world, characters and audio are procedural, with no external models or sound files.
worksToday: Walk from Crosscamp to the Chrome Needle across a continuous map.
A phone with no saved setting starts on Low quality.
limitations: I checked that the title screen loads, not the whole slice.
Quality and performance vary a lot between devices.

media.alt: The Echofield title card over a misty low-poly grassland with red tents, offering 'Begin walk' and Low, Medium and High quality buttons.
media.caption: The title screen of the hosted build.

involve.headline: How does it run for you?
asks: Tell me what quality setting your device handled.
